title: Signal: Composer dependency declared with a wildcard
scope: A composer.json file that declares a `require` entry whose constraint is `*`.
limitations: It matches a `require` entry whose constraint is `*` in the parsed composer.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A composer.json that mentions a `require` entry whose constraint is `*` in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
